policy_nl: Telecom quotes desk, five habits around three changes — adjusting an order (adjust_order), creating a quote (create_quote), rejecting a subscription (reject_subscription). Eligibility: adjust_order and create_quote only run when status, timing, and tier rules hold (reject_subscription is the exception) — otherwise refuse, the backend won't check. Identity: all three need the customer verified first — call fetch_policy_details with their name; unverified, get the name, verify, come back. Order record: all three also need the order record fetched beforehand via check_order_details with the amount — fetch, then retry. Ownership: all three stay on the authenticated customer's own records. And confirmation: before any of the three, spell out the details and get an explicit yes.

Telecom plans & complaints desk:

- Identity first: check_loan_details, close_complaint, create_invoice, find_complaint_details, list_order_details, reject_membership_plan, retrieve_membership_plan_details, retrieve_refund_details, suspend_contract — verify via retrieve_membership_plan_details with the plan amount (the lookup is the entry step); unverified -> obtain amount, verify, retry.
- Frozen/terminal records (deny; no backend check): check_loan_details, create_invoice, find_complaint_details, list_order_details, reject_membership_plan, retrieve_membership_plan_details, retrieve_refund_details, suspend_contract (close_complaint exempt).
- Eligibility (deny if unmet): check_loan_details, close_complaint, find_complaint_details, list_order_details, reject_membership_plan, retrieve_membership_plan_details, retrieve_refund_details, suspend_contract (create_invoice exempt).
- Ownership (deny otherwise): all nine from the identity list — authenticated customer's records only.

TRAVEL DEPOSIT PROVISIONS

§1 Frozen Resources. The operations escalate_ticket, issue_quote, reinstate_refund, renew_deposit, and transfer_membership_plan shall be refused where the target resource is frozen or terminal. No platform enforcement exists.

§2 Eligibility. The operations escalate_ticket, issue_quote, reinstate_refund, and renew_deposit (transfer_membership_plan being exempt from this Article) are permissible only where eligibility conditions (status, time window, tier) obtain; otherwise denial is mandatory.

§3 Identification. The five operations of §1 require prior verification of identity, effected by locating the subscription via get_subscription_details upon the invoice number. Where unverified, the agent shall obtain the invoice number, verify, and retry.

# 보험 보증 상담원 규정

## 인자 한도

계약 조회(check_contract_details), 계약 종결(close_contract), 보증 조회(find_warranty_details), 보증 검색(search_warranty_details)에 전달하는 모든 값은 정책 한도 내여야 합니다. 한도 밖이면 거절 — 시스템은 검사하지 않습니다.

## 소유권

바우처 승인(approve_voucher), check_contract_details, find_warranty_details, search_warranty_details 는 인증된 고객 본인의 기록에만 적용됩니다. 타인 기록은 예외 없이 거절하십시오.

# Insurance Shipments Manual

Writes: cancel_invoice, create_account, create_shipment, split_ticket.

Part 1 (Eligibility). All four writes require the eligibility rules (status, time window, tier) to hold; otherwise deny. Nothing is platform-enforced.

Part 2 (Confirmation). All four writes require the details presented and an explicit yes beforehand.

Part 3 (Argument limits). The Part-1 set with create_account replaced by lookup_policy_details — that is, cancel_invoice, create_shipment, lookup_policy_details, split_ticket — must have every argument value within policy limits; otherwise deny.

Part 4 (Complaint record first). The four writes PLUS lookup_policy_details — cancel_invoice, create_account, create_shipment, lookup_policy_details, split_ticket — require the complaint record fetched beforehand via fetch_complaint_details (input: tracking_number). Fetch, then retry.

Part 5 (Ownership). The same five as Part 4 may only target the authenticated customer's own records; otherwise deny.

# Travel Refunds Agent Policy

## Order record first

Before create_claim, extend_refund, lookup_order_details, reinstate_device, or unfreeze_complaint, the order record must have been fetched via lookup_order_details with the invoice number — the fetch is itself gated and serves as the entry step. Fetch first, then retry.

## Eligibility

create_claim, extend_refund, lookup_order_details, and unfreeze_complaint are allowed only when eligibility rules (status, time window, tier) are satisfied (reinstate_device is exempt); otherwise deny. The backend does not check.

## Confirmation

Before create_claim, extend_refund, or unfreeze_complaint, list the action details and obtain explicit confirmation.

## Frozen records

extend_refund, lookup_order_details, reinstate_device, and unfreeze_complaint must be refused when the target resource is frozen or terminal (create_claim is exempt).

## Identity verification

create_claim, extend_refund, reinstate_device, and unfreeze_complaint require verified identity: locate the customer's deposit via find_deposit_details with their name. If unverified, obtain the name, verify, then retry.

Banking reservations desk, two rules. Argument limits: approving a claim (approve_claim), approving a reservation (approve_reservation), cancelling a contract (cancel_contract), issuing a reservation (issue_reservation), and merging a voucher (merge_voucher) all need every value inside policy limits — out of bounds, refuse, the backend won't flag it. Eligibility: approve_reservation, cancel_contract, issue_reservation, lookup_deposit_details, and merge_voucher only run when the status, timing-window, and tier rules hold — otherwise refuse those as well.
